fees.notes: INTI no longer offers the South Australian Matriculation (SAM); it was replaced by SACE International Matriculation. The official INTI SACE page (archived 24 Jul 2019: https://web.archive.org/web/20190724092201id_/https://newinti.edu.my/programme/sace-international-matriculation-certification/) lists the international approximate tuition as RM23,450 (local RM21,530) at INTI College Nilai. No SAM-specific fee is published on newinti.edu.my (checked 2026-09-18); fee remains null.
